text: If you stopped eating sugar for
two weeks, which may sound like
torture for most sugar-addicted ghouls,
but if you do,
this is what would actually happen.
First, you're going to lose your
pathetic cravings for sugar,
and you'll finally be able to
go longer than two hours without
food. Why? Because eating sugar spikes
a hormone called insulin to clear
that sugar out of your blood,
triggering a violent blood sugar crash
right after that tricks your brain
into thinking you're starving to death
when you literally just ate.
Cut the sugar and your blood
sugar stabilizes, while also starving out
the freeloading gut bacteria in your
stomach that hijack your nervous system
to beg for junk food.
Next, you're going to have a
lot more energy.
Actual energy, not a 20-minute
sugar high before you feel like
a sedated sloth.
Because once your insulin stays low,
it unlocks your fat cells,
forcing your body to tap into
your own fat reserves to produce
steady energy. Naturally,
you're going to lose more weight
once your body finally starts cannibalizing
the fat you've been storing since
2021. If you've been depressed or
crippled with anxiety,
you're going to feel noticeably more
up. Because those constant blood sugar
crashes flood your system with cortisol,
your main stress hormone,
meaning half your existential dread is
really just a diet problem.
Plus, sugar physically inflames your brain
tissue. Cut it out and you'll
start thinking better with real concentration
and focus instead of staring blankly
at your screen for 40 minutes.
You're also going to notice your
skin is a lot better and
actually has a healthy glow instead
of looking like an embalmed corpse.
Because sugar causes glycation,
a process where sugar molecules glue
themselves to the collagen proteins holding
your face together and literally rot
them from the inside.
Finally, throughout your entire body,
there's going to be way less
inflammation and pain.
Because you stop forcing your immune
system to pump out inflammatory chemicals
called cytokines. So your knees might
finally stop sounding like bubble wrap
every time you stand up.
